clarification_literal: Precisão do escopo mecânico: pode calcular hash/tamanho dos arquivos referidos por semantic_review_refs sem imprimir, interpretar ou incluir seus conteúdos no contexto/relatório; isso não autoriza ler o texto dos pareceres. O oracle do contrato fica fora desta pré-conferência e será conferido pelo principal. A verificação de fonte/corpo é por bytes, sem exibir prosa ou introduzir novas interpretações.

transport.note: Current ten-artifact envelope only; final upper-layer assembly and new binding remain outside this plan.

exclusions.contract_oracle: EXCLUDED; principal checks separately; bytes not opened

method.byte_identity: SHA-256 of bytes; Git blob is SHA-1 of blob + space + decimal length + NUL + bytes, without executing Git.
method.metadata_closure: Direct transport refs/body paths and file input_keys. Declared JSON recipes supply expected digests only for the 21 file inputs that lack direct reference digests. Historical recipe references do not override current source_refs.
method.path_safety: Canonical relative path validation, lstat on each path component without following symlinks, stable file identity checked during each hash read. No atomic global snapshot claimed.
method.input_key_changes: Proposals only. Current arrays remain in the unchanged transport; this plan records their counts/order flags and sorted proposed arrays with the protocol and driver additions.
method.kernel_ids: NOT_COMPUTED; transport digests are not kernel IDs.
method.compact_identity_encoding: When verification.sha256 or verification.git_blob_sha is true, the selected file hash equals the corresponding sole expected digest; equal digests are not repeated in materialize_from. PRESENT_MATCH means all declared digests and byte lengths match. Unpinned driver and differing local versions retain their observed digests.

notes: Use exact matching source locations, not blanket copies from protocol/ or runtime.
The five flattened protocol files SKILL, fatia-4, principles, runtime and transport differ from declared bytes. Exact versions are available at the per-file locations.
Preserve runtime-release R2 pin 8a041ca and use producers/l2a/inputs/runtime-release.json for that source path, while runtime code remains separate.
Driver bytes are mapped as a future common input. Its execution and static judgment are not evaluated here.
Five pending L3/L4 artifacts are excluded from coverage and readiness claims.
